items.docs: When an organization member is converted to an outside collaborator, they'll only have access to the repositories that their current team membership allows. The user will no longer be a member of the organization. For more information, see "[Converting an organization member to an outside collaborator](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/articles/converting-an-organization-member-to-an-outside-collaborator/)". items.docs:
The "Get team member" endpoint (described below) is deprecated.

We recommend using the [Get team membership for a user](https://docs.github.com/enterprise-server@3.9/rest/teams/members#get-team-membership-for-a-user) endpoint instead. It allows you to get both active and pending memberships.

To list members in a team, the team must be visible to the authenticated user.
